func commands() []command {
	return []command{
		{name: "version", summary: "Print version and build information", flags: versionFlags},
		{name: "init", summary: "Initialize harness state for this repository", flags: initFlags},
		{name: "status", summary: "Show project, Git, database and client state", flags: statusFlags},
		{name: "sync", summary: "Refresh recorded project state (worktree, branch, HEAD)", flags: syncFlags},
		hooksCommand(),
		tasksCommand(),
		proposalsCommand(),
		memoryCommand(),
		contextCommand(),
		projectsCommand(),
		workspaceCommand(),
		{name: "search", summary: "Search code in this project, or across its workspace (--workspace, --deep)", args: "<query...>", minArgs: 1, maxArgs: -1, flags: searchFlags},
		{name: "metrics", summary: "How the MCP tools and provider capabilities fared: calls, errors, empty answers, latency",
			flags: metricsFlags},
		{name: "report", summary: "Findings to steer harness: relevance, provider and tool health, bypasses, knowledge use",
			about: "Each finding states its numbers and suggests an action; thresholds are in internal/report.", flags: reportFlags},
		{name: "ui", summary: "Open the local GUI: every harness project on this machine, its telemetry, knowledge and tasks",
			about: uiAbout, flags: uiFlags},
		{name: "doctor", summary: "Diagnose problems and suggest fixes", flags: doctorFlags},
		docsCommand(),
		providersCommand(),
		{name: "install", summary: "Add the harness MCP server to Claude Code / Codex config", flags: clientConfigFlags("install")},
		{name: "uninstall", summary: "Remove the harness MCP server from client config", flags: clientConfigFlags("uninstall")},
		{name: "instructions", summary: "Add/update/remove the harness guidance: AGENTS.md (or an existing CLAUDE.md), one place only", flags: instructionsFlags},
		{name: "mcp", summary: "Serve MCP over stdio for host agents", flags: mcpFlags},
		completionCommand(),
		telemetryCommand(),
		{name: "help", summary: "Show help (harness help <command> [<subcommand>])", args: "[command...]", raw: runHelp},
	}
}

functions.declaration:
func hooksCommand() command {
	return command{name: "hooks", aliases: []string{"hook"},
		summary: "Install, uninstall or inspect optional hooks: Git sync and client tool events",
		about: "Hook kinds (--kind, comma-separated or 'all'):\n" +
			"  git          Git hooks that run 'harness sync' whenever HEAD moves: commits,\n" +
			"               checkouts, merges (including fast-forward) and rebases.\n" +
			"  claude-code  A Claude Code PostToolUse hook that records what the agent read,\n" +
			"               edited and called (names and repository paths only, never contents),\n" +
			"               to score get_context before any commit and spot provider bypasses;\n" +
			"               and a SessionStart hook that tells the agent, in a repository using\n" +
			"               harness, to start with get_context (and its subagents too).\n" +
			"  codex        The same for Codex (hooks.json); Codex asks once to trust it (/hooks).\n" +
			"Client hooks go in user settings by default (--scope user|project|local).",
		defaultSub: "choose",
		subs: []command{
			{name: "choose", summary: "Check or uncheck the hooks to install (interactive; outside a terminal it shows the status)",
				flags: hooksChooseFlags},
			{name: "install", summary: "Add harness's hooks of the chosen kinds (default git)", flags: hooksFlags("install")},
			{name: "uninstall", summary: "Remove only harness's hooks of the chosen kinds (default git)", flags: hooksFlags("uninstall")},
			{name: "status", summary: "Show which hooks are installed (every kind by default)", flags: hooksFlags("status")},
			{name: "event", summary: "Record one client tool event (run by the client hook; reads its payload on stdin)", flags: hookEventFlags},
			{name: "session", summary: "Tell the agent this repository uses harness (run by Claude Code's SessionStart hook)", flags: hookSessionFlags},
		}}
}

functions.signature: func taskFlags(name string, flags func(*flag.FlagSet) taskRun) func(*flag.FlagSet) action {

functions.declaration:
func tasksCommand() command {
	id := func(name, summary string, flags func(*flag.FlagSet) taskRun) command {
		return command{name: name, summary: summary, args: "<id>", minArgs: 1, maxArgs: 1, flags: taskFlags(name, flags)}
	}
	return command{name: "tasks", aliases: []string{"task"}, summary: "Operate the task queue (list, next, claim, complete, import...)",
		about: "Humans act as a privileged actor (human:<user>): no claim token is needed, and every action is recorded in the task's audit trail.\n\n" +
			"Tasks come from a backlog file ('harness tasks import --help' describes its format with an example), are added by hand ('harness tasks add'), " +
			"or are proposed by agents and approved by you ('harness tasks proposals', or harness ui, Work › Inbox).",
		subs: []command{
			{name: "list", summary: "List tasks", flags: taskFlags("list", taskList)},
			{name: "milestones", summary: "List milestones: goal, exit criteria and task progress", flags: taskFlags("milestones", taskMilestones)},
			id("show", "Show one task", taskShow),
			{name: "next", summary: "Show the next ready task", flags: taskFlags("next", taskNext)},
			id("claim", "Claim a ready task", taskClaim),
			id("complete", "Complete a claimed task with evidence", taskComplete),
			id("block", "Block a task (something is wrong and needs attention)", taskBlock),
			id("defer", "Defer a task by a decision; --reason says when to bring it back", taskDefer),
			id("ready", "Unblock or bring back a deferred task (ready if its dependencies are done)", taskReady),
			id("release", "Release a claim", taskRelease),
			{name: "import", summary: "Import/update task definitions from a backlog file", args: "[file]", maxArgs: 1,
				about: backlogFormat, flags: taskFlags("import", taskImport)},
			{name: "add", summary: "Add a task by hand (the next free id of the backlog's prefix)", flags: taskFlags("add", taskAdd),
				about: "Example:\n  harness tasks add --title \"Measure startup\" --goal \"Know where the 2 s go\" --accept \"a profile is in bench/results\" --depends TASK-0041\n\n" +
					"The task lives in the project's database; 'harness tasks export' writes it into the backlog file."},
			{name: "export", summary: "Write the tasks the backlog file lacks into it (made by hand, proposed by agents, from findings)", args: "[file]", maxArgs: 1,
				flags: taskFlags("export", taskExport)},
			{name: "proposals", summary: "List the tasks agents proposed (approve or reject them here or in harness ui, Work › Inbox)", flags: taskFlags("proposals", taskProposals)},
			{name: "approve", summary: "Approve an agent's task proposal: the task is created", args: "<proposal>", minArgs: 1, maxArgs: 1, flags: taskFlags("approve", taskApprove)},
			{name: "reject", summary: "Reject an agent's task proposal", args: "<proposal>", minArgs: 1, maxArgs: 1, flags: taskFlags("reject", taskReject)},
		}}
}
